comment: docs/notes3 Part C5: float32 activations x DenseShift weights -> float32 sums (paper Sec. 3.1.1): the product is an integer add on the exponent field plus a sign flip, so each MAC is one float add (~2 DSP48E1) instead of a float multiply-add (~5). float32 kernels/gemm topped out at PE 32x8 (256 MACs, 1320 DSP); here PE 32x16 (512 MACs) and PE 48x16 (768 MACs; tile 384x1024 keeps the C buffer at depth 512). Results checked bit for bit against k-order float sums.
